newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Blast kills two pro-Israel militiamen in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Blast kills two pro-Israel militiamen in Lebanon.

text.p: A roadside charge blew up and killed two pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army (SLA) militiamen and wounded two others in the Jewish state's south Lebanon occupation zone on Friday, Israeli security sources said.
They said the incident occurred in the eastern sector of Israel's self-declared security zone.
Israel carved out the 15-km (nine-mile) -wide occupation zone when it withdrew the bulk of its 1982 Lebanon invasion force in 1985.
Pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas are fighting to oust Israel from the zone.

In April, Israel launched an air, sea, and naval bombardment against Lebanon in retaliation for guerrilla rocket attacks on northern Israel. Some 200 Lebanese, most civilians, were killed in the onslaught. No Israelis were killed.
That fighting ended with a U.S.-brokered ceasefire forbidding the sides to fire from or on civilian areas.
